[FAQ](https://www.scouting.org/about/faq/) > Must individuals who are serving
as a merit badge counselor register as a merit badge counselor with Scouting
America?

# Must individuals who are serving as a merit badge counselor register as a
merit badge counselor with Scouting America?

Yes, an Adult Application must be completed for each position in which the
individual wants to serve. The application allows only one position per form.
For instance, an individual who wants to serve only as a merit badge counselor
will need to complete only one application. However, a Scoutmaster or
assistant Scoutmaster who wants to serve as a merit badge counselor must
complete two applications—one for the Scoutmaster position and one for the
counselor position.
